edits.old: Then the access event records a result count of 0
edits.new:
Then the access event records a result count of 0

  Scenario: AC11 A role without Documents R is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given user "TEST-CAP-01" holds RW-CAPACITY, which has no Documents R
    When "TEST-CAP-01" searches type "APPRAISAL_REPORT"
    Then the system refuses the request with 403 and MSG-P4-002
    Then no query runs and no access record is written

  Scenario: AC12 The case-list read does not answer in time (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock does not answer within 2 seconds
    When "TEST-LIT-01" searches type "APPRAISAL_REPORT"
    Then the system refuses the request with 503 and MSG-GEN-006 naming "Case service"
    Then no query runs and no access record is written

  Scenario: AC13 The authorise read does not answer in time (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-access contract mock does not answer within 2 seconds
    When "TEST-LIT-01" searches type "APPRAISAL_REPORT"
    Then the system refuses the request with 503 and MSG-GEN-006 naming "Access service"
    Then no query runs and no access record is written

  Scenario: AC14 The date criterion is the stored date (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given "TEST-LIT-01" is on the Document search page
    When "TEST-LIT-01" searches type "APPRAISAL_REPORT", stored from 1 October 2026 to 31 October 2026
    Then every listed document has a stored date from 1 October 2026 to 31 October 2026
